The immutable Hub package is the public Hub SDK and CLI packed (`npm pack`) from AgentOrg `426abca58bb806f0fead1abbd6ddd89ac82fb889`, tree `c115dece60415b7cdb16ccd1e8c20a47a35314db`: `@agentorg/cli` 0.0.2, the flat organization ([AgentOrg PRs 77](https://github.com/uniac-ai/AgentOrg/pull/77) to [81](https://github.com/uniac-ai/AgentOrg/pull/81)), with Workspace 0.0.2. Once it is on npm, this archive is the same bytes the registry serves.

`agentorg-cli-0.0.2.tgz` has SHA256 `47fba3ec9743d883d4c0a9f9ee5f3de7361f22b4418ccd1ab0197af6b54e9559`. Production imports only its public `@agentorg/cli/contract` schemas/types. Tests additionally launch its public `agentorg-server` command against an owned temporary home and use exported Actor APIs. No sibling checkout or private server/storage imports are used.

The Hub bundles `@uniac/agentic-workspace` 0.0.2, MIT-licensed, at `8aebc44`: every Actor on one flat level; asks on Work, routed to the Work's requester, or to the person when the asker requested it itself, answered with `work_answer`; approvals answered only by the Actor they route to; submissions answered by their requester; and Messages in their pair's conversation. The full Hub catalog has 8 Tools and 21 interfaces, all offered to every Actor. Test fixtures always use new empty homes.
